steps.content: EXPORT ZZT_IMREAD() BEGIN HComplex:=10; LOCAL T:=L1(1), R:=approx(L1(3)); LOCAL TMP:=approx(T); LOCAL PRODUCT:=TMP*TMP; RETURN {TYPE(T),STRING(T),TYPE(L1(2)),STRING(L1(2)),TYPE(R),RE(R),IM(R),TYPE(TMP),RE(TMP),IM(TMP),TYPE(PRODUCT),ROUND(RE(PRODUCT),10),IM(PRODUCT),TYPE(IM(T)),STRING(IM(T)),approx(IM(T))}; END;
